name: The Counselor Trap
source:
Marcy is obsessed with vampires and art – and this summer camp has both! Help her make friends and solve the mystery of the scary nurse... Is he really a vampire?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
